book.name: Luka
book.title: Saaka wù joŋe kune Jiso no Luka gɛ̀ saŋ

content: Keefɛ muh jɛ̂me yeye wù gee yeye gɛ
No Jiso gɛ̀ jɛmɛ, binchvu bi bamii mo bi taashi bi too fo banchvuge le banchvuge le bo faase wu. Bamu jiɛnyi bikaa bi bamu. Jiso ja wu kɛ wu tu wu jɛme nyu booŋ be ba ŋgoo le wu duu lɛ,

content.text: “Bɛŋ jôde kife bɛ kinshilɛ ki Bafalashii ki le gee chiboo chì bo jɛme yeye, bo gee yeye.
Bɛŋ kêe lɛ fiɛɛ fì ba nyile fi kɛme ki fi to fi bu fɛ waaŋ. Gɛ fiɛɛ nyu yu tɛ fì ba nyile fì lé fi gê njɛ ba kɛ̂ɛ sɛŋ gɛ.
Bɛŋ kêe lɛ fiɛɛ fichii fì bɛŋ jɛme antaŋ lé ba nyû ba yû fɛnshɛ. Fiɛɛ fichii fì bɛŋ fale yeh bɛŋ chvuune lo lé ba nyû ba tô ba jaŋ lo fɛ kigo ki yeh le.
Nsáa yaŋ, njɛme bɛŋ le lɛ keefɛ bɛŋ fâane bamii ba taŋlo bo yuuyɛ gɛh nyume nyaŋ yi ye maa, njɛ taŋlo bo ka bo ge fiɛɛ fimi sɛŋ gɛ.
Bɛŋ yêgɛ bɛŋ yû muh wù bɛŋ fâane, bɛŋ fâne nyu Nyo nje le wu wù kɛme bvuŋga ki wu yûuyɛ muh, wu ka wu leesɛ mwɛdɛ yi ŋgu wù baaŋ le. Ŋka njɛme bɛŋ le lɛ bɛŋ fâane gɛh nyu wu maa.
Gɛ bɛŋ kee lɛ ba to ba gese munsɛŋ muntɛŋ yi munini le munfɛɛ maa gɛ? Geenɛ, gɛ finsɛŋ fimi nyu yu fimimia fì Nyo to wu daayi a fi le gɛ.
Fiena le lɛ Nyo kee yvú yichii yì le a bɛŋ fwa. Keefɛ bɛŋ fâane gɛ. Bɛŋ fede munsɛŋ mù duude.

content: Muh wu mbɛmɛ bɛ muh wù faaŋe Jiso

content.text: Nsɛŋe tɛ bɛŋ le lɛ, muh bɛmɛ mɛ a bamii fwe lɛ wu kee mɛ, tu muh wù jee che le Mwamuh lé wu gê wu bɛ̂ɛŋ tɛ mwɛdɛ a banchɛndaa ba Nyo fwe lɛ wu kee wu.
Geenɛ muh ma lo mɛ a bamii fwe tu mɛ tɛ nlé mmâ mwɛdɛ a banchɛndaa ba Nyo jii.
Fi ka nyume lɛ, Nyo lé wu gê wu lɛ̂ɛshɛ jɛ́ yì befe yì muh jɛme kune muh wù jee che le lɛ Mwamuh, geenɛ gɛ Nyo nyu wu yu wu to wu lɛɛshɛ jɛ́ yì befe yì muh jɛme kune Kiyo ki Yuude gɛ.

Sege ba koo bɛŋ ba gɛɛŋ bɛ bɛŋ yéh yi buunɛ le, kɛnɛ nyu fwe a bamii ba sage woŋ, kɛnɛ nyu fwe a bamii ba kɛme bvuŋga bvù bo sage tɛ, lɛ bo gɛɛŋ bo sa bɛŋ, keefɛ kikwɛɛ fûuŋse bɛŋ laa bɛŋ le bɛŋ gɛɛŋ bɛŋ taanyi jwe bɛŋ duu lɛ la lɛ, kɛnɛ bɛŋ jɛme nɛɛ lɛ.
Lé gê nyume kife kiyu le, Kiyo ki Yuude sɛɛŋ bɛŋ fiɛɛ fì bɛŋ lé bɛŋ jɛ̂mɛ.”

content: Ŋgaŋ kune kiyuŋ ki muh kwa
No Jiso gɛ̀ teede booŋ be ba ŋgoo le noo, muh mu ja wu jɛmɛ antɛnɛɛ a kinchvu ki bamii le, wu du wu le lɛ, “Muh wu N'yɛyɛ, du Mwa bwɛɛŋ le lɛ wu ga bvushɛ bwesa wu nya bwaŋ.”

content.text: “Jwɛŋsɛ, gɛle yɛɛŋ mɛ lɛ nsûune bansa bena, ŋka ŋgâde bvushɛ bwena?”

content: No wu biide noo wu mo wu jɛmɛ muh wuchii le lɛ,

content.text: “Bɛŋ jôde kife bɛŋ yɛ̂ne keefɛ bɛŋ yɛ̂ɛde ajii yi mwɛɛ le gɛ, nje gɛ kinche kimu nyu njɛ mwɛɛ mu wù kɛme gɛ, mo mwɛdɛ tu wù kɛme bvukugɛ nɛɛ la.”

content: No wu jɛmɛ noo, wu mo wu ma ŋgaŋ lɛ,

content.text: “Muh wu kwa wumu gɛ̀ kɛme mwɛ we, mwɛɛ joŋ yu baaŋ.
Wu mo wu kɛ wu kwaji lɛ laa wu lé wu gê nɛɛ la? Wu lé wu gɛ̂ɛ ŋgu ye yɛɛ faaŋ la?
Wu mo wu ja wu chu ntaŋ lɛ, ‘Fiɛɛ fì nlé ŋgê le finɛ. Nlé nsâ basaŋkwa baŋ, ŋkâasɛ njôoŋ ba kuge, mo ŋgɛ̂ɛ ŋgu bɛ mwɛɛ mwaŋ yu munchii.
Ndoo ŋge noo, mɛ mo ndu kikwɛɛ kaŋ le lɛ nle muh wu kishi. Ŋkɛme mwɛɛ mù nlé ŋgê njîi biluŋ bì duude le. Gɛ mbaaŋ ntu mbuge gɛ. Nlé njîi gɛh wa lo, ŋka mmuu n'yuge njoŋ.’
No wu seese noo, Nyo mo wu tɛɛŋ wu lɛ, ‘Kiyuŋ kinɛ! Kintaŋ ki abɛŋ le nlé ŋkâasɛ njô kiyo kuŋ. N'yɛŋ laa mwɛɛ munɛ munchii mù wo seese wo gɛɛ lé gê nyû mu yɛɛŋ la?’”

content: No Jiso jɛme nɛ wu mo wu jɛmɛ lɛ,

content.text: “Le gɛh yɛɛŋyɛɛŋ no fì lé fi gê fi nyû fɛ muh wu banyi bvukugɛ fɛ kikwɛɛ ke le wù kɛme gɛ bvukugɛ kimbe ki Nyo le gɛ.”

content: Ba gɛ̂ɛde muntele nyu yi Nyo le
Wu ka wu ja wu jɛme wa nyu booŋ be ba ŋgoo le lɛ,

content.text: “Keefɛ bɛŋ lûume kune kinche kena lɛ laa bɛŋ lé bɛŋ gê bɛŋ jî la lɛ, kɛnɛ kune ye yene lɛ laa bɛŋ lé bɛŋ jîi la lɛ.
Bɛŋ kêe lɛ kiyo ki muh fede mwɛɛ munjile, ye yi muh fede njú.
Bɛŋ jîŋɛ bɛŋ yɛŋ biŋaŋa, gɛ bi to bi lɛne gɛ, gɛ bi to bi gweji ŋgu gɛ. Gɛ bi kɛme basaŋkwa kɛnɛ baŋwaŋ gɛ. Geenɛ Nyo nyaŋe gɛh bi bichii. Gɛ bɛŋ kee lɛ bɛŋ yage munyii gɛ?
Le yɛɛŋ a bɛŋ ntɛnɛɛ wù fuuŋse, wù taŋlo wu bisɛ gɛh kife shige yi kinche ke le?
No gɛ taŋlo bɛŋ ge mo fì shige finɛ gɛ, gee la fì bɛŋ soge bikwɛɛ kune mwɛɛ munɛ?

Bɛŋ jîŋɛ bɛŋ yɛ̂ŋ no nfudɛ to wu kuu wù nyu. Gɛ nfudɛ to wu lɛne gɛ, gɛ wu shiŋe njú gɛ. Geenɛ, nsɛŋe bɛŋ le lɛ gɛh Nfoŋ Salamoŋ bɛ bvukugɛ bwe bvuchii bvù wu gɛ̀ kɛme wu gɛ̀ suse ye wu bu fɛ nfudɛ le gɛ.
No Nyo suse agaaŋ a nchvuuŋ nɛ, agaaŋ a kuu abɛŋ, bu antaana ba fwɛɛ lo fɛtaŋ, tu gɛ taŋlo wu susɛ bɛŋ wu fe lo noo gɛ? O oo bamii ba mbɛmɛ wù shige lɛ!
Fi mo fi nyu lɛ keefɛ fi fûuŋse bɛŋ gɛ, keefɛ bɛŋ kwâji laa bɛŋ lé bɛŋ jî la bɛŋ tu bɛŋ mû la lɛ,
nje munɛ mwɛɛ to kwaji gɛh bamii ba bituŋ bi yi nshɛŋ yinɛ le. Bɛŋ kêe lɛ Chiji wene kee lo lɛ bɛŋ koŋe mwɛɛ munɛ munchii.
Bɛŋ gɛ̂ɛ bvufee bwena nyu yi bvunfoŋ bvu Nyo le, wu mo wu nyaa tɛ mwɛɛ munɛ munchii bɛŋ le.
Ŋgoo yaŋ, no bɛŋ le shige nɛ, keefɛ bɛŋ fâane gɛ, nje Chiji wene le wu koŋ wa ki wu nyâ bvunfoŋ bɛŋ le.

Bɛŋ gesɛ mwɛɛ mu bɛŋ kɛmɛ, bɛŋ ga bige biyu bamii ba fuude le, bɛŋ gôone bikɛɛ nyu bì taŋlo bi gɛ suumɛ gɛ. Bɛŋ gɛ̂ɛde kwa wene nyu yi woŋ wù Nyo le, fɛ taŋlo wu gɛ ka gɛ, fɛ choŋ taŋlo wu gɛ fe fo gɛ, fɛ shé taŋlo yi gɛ kaaŋ gɛ.
Bɛŋ kêe lɛ fɛ muh gɛɛde nchvu ye fo le fɛ fitele fie le fo.
Bɛŋ kaaŋ bicha biɛna, bɛŋ chu bin'yesɛ bɛŋ chîɛɛne lɛme,
gɛh njɛ booŋ ba lɛme to bo chiɛɛne kikwɛɛ kiboo wù nyu kijusɛ ki bvuguu le. Wu doo wu kaasɛ wu to wu kuŋ kimbuŋ ba gwenyɛ lo wu lee.

Kinlaŋye kì baaŋ le ki nyu fɛ booŋ ba lɛme le sege kikwɛɛ kiboo fɛsɛ wu yɛŋ bo nyu we bo chiɛɛne wu. Nsɛŋe bɛŋ nchiɛɛŋ lɛ wu lé wu gê wu chɛ̂mɛ nju ye wu kaaŋ, bo shiiyɛ fɛkuu wu to bɛ mwɛɛ munjile wu gajɛ bo le.
Kinlaŋye kì baaŋ le ki nyu ki booŋ ba lɛme ba wu lé wu gê wu fɛ̂sɛ wu yɛ̂ŋ bo nyu bo chiɛɛne wu. Kɛnɛ wu lé wu gê wu tô antaŋ antɛnɛɛ, kɛnɛ sege nyishii to yi toŋe.
Bɛŋ kêe lɛ chiji yeh nɛ kee kife ki choŋ le wu to, tu wu lé wu chîɛɛne. Wu gɛ̀ chinɛ lɛ ba ŋgode yeh ye gɛ.
Bɛŋ tɛ kɛme ki bɛŋ chîɛɛne, nje muh wù jee che le Mwamuh lé wu gê wu kâasɛ wu to kife kì bɛŋ kee gɛ le.”

content: Bita mo wu ja wu biih wu le lɛ, “Tada, wo ma ŋgaŋ wunɛ nyu bee le, noo bamii bachii le lɛ?”

content.text: “Mwa lɛme wu le wù nchiɛɛŋ wù ka kɛme bvufee le wù la? Gɛ nyume muh wɛɛ wù chiji kikwɛɛ ke le wu gɛɛ wu lɛ wu jîiŋe fɛ yeh ye le, sege kife doo ki kojɛ wu nya mwɛɛ munjile booŋ be ba lɛme le gɛ?
Kinlaŋye kì baaŋ lé ki gê ki nyûme ki mwa lɛme wù chiji kikwɛɛ ke, sege wu doo wu too wu yɛŋ wù gee lɛme gɛh yɛɛŋyɛɛŋ no wu bee ki wù gee.
Nsɛŋe bɛŋ nchiɛɛŋ lɛ chiji kikwɛɛ ke lé wu gê wu bɛ̂ɛŋsɛ wu, wu jiiŋe fɛ mwɛɛ mwe le munchii.
Geenɛ, nɛ mwa lɛme wɛɛ ja wu jɛmɛ kikwɛɛ ke le lɛ, ‘Gɛ chiji kikwɛɛ kaŋ nyu wu yaŋsɛ wu kaasɛ gɛ’, wu mo wu kɛ wu suŋe booŋ ba lɛme ba bilɛŋsɛ mo ba bikɛse, wu jii wu ka muu mbvuuŋ mo koode wu,

chiji kikwɛɛ ke lé wu gê wu jâ gɛh wu bûnɛ juu chimi chì wu be kwaji gɛ bɛ kife kì wu be kee gɛ le. Wu doo wu ge wu bu noo, wu mo wu gwoojɛ lo mwa ye wu lɛme wɛɛ, wu chiiŋsɛ wu wu gɛɛŋ wù nyu bɛ bamii ba lɛme gɛ jɛ yi boo le gɛ.
Mwa lɛme wù kee fiɛɛ fì chiji kikwɛɛ ke goone lɛ wu gêe, wu baaŋ seesɛ gɛ ye ki wu gêe gɛ, tu ba lé ba tâaŋ wu bɛ munte wesee.

Mwa lɛme wɛɛ wu kee gɛ fiɛɛ fì chiji kikwɛɛ ke goone lɛ wu gêe gɛ, wu fɛ fiɛɛ fì taŋlo ba taaŋ wu bɛ munte wesee, lé ba nyû ba wêjɛ gɛh lo wuwɛɛ shige. Muh wù ba nya mwɛɛ wu le wesee le wu wù ba lé ba gôone mwɛɛ wu le wesee. Muh wù ba le ba gɛɛ mwɛɛ chiaaŋ ye le wesee lé ba nyû ba bîih mwɛɛ wu le wesee.”

content: Jiso ka wu jɛmɛ booŋ be ba ŋgoo le lɛ,

content.text: “Nto ki nfwɛɛ nyu ŋgu yi nshɛŋ le. Muh jo lɛ wu be bɛde wa lo.
Ŋkɛme kfuu chi ŋgɛ wù baaŋ wumu ki nlee wu le, fitele fiaŋ lé fi jɛ̂de gɛh sege nlé nlêe wa wu le.
Bɛŋ kwaji lɛ nto nyu bɛ kimbonɛ yi nshɛŋ le fɛnɛ? Ŋgaŋ! Bɛŋ kêe lɛ nto nyu bɛ kiŋgaye.
Kɛge yi mɛɛse le gɛɛne fwe, yeh yì le bɛ bamii batɛŋ lé yi gê yi gâ ye. Bamii batɛde lé bo gê bo gâ ye bɛ ba bafɛɛ, ba bafɛɛ ga ye bɛ ba batɛde.

Chiji mwa lé wu gê wu gâ ye bɛ mwa ye wù jwɛŋsɛ, mwa wù jwɛŋsɛ juu bɛ chiji. Bwe mwa lé wu gê wu jûu bɛ mwa ye wù kwɛse, mwa wù kwɛse juu bɛ bwee. Bwe jwɛŋsɛ lé wu gê wu jûu bɛ kwɛ mwa ye, kwɛ mwa juu bɛ bwe jwɛɛŋ.”

content: Jiso gɛ̀ du kinchvu ki bamii le lɛ,

content.text: “Bɛŋ to bɛŋ yɛde sege kimbɛ bɛɛne je ajuu seele yo, bɛŋ mo bɛŋ duu lɛ, ‘Jaŋ lé yi gwê.’ Yi ge yi mo yi gwe.
Sege bɛŋ yɛde tɛ nfuŋ bɛɛne je akuu akuu, bɛŋ mo bɛŋ tu bɛŋ duu lɛ, ‘Kiyufɛ kì baaŋ lé ki nyû yu.’ Ki mo ki nyûme yu.
Bɛŋ bamii ba jɛme yeye, bɛŋ tu bɛŋ gee yeye banɛ, no bɛŋ jiiŋe kibvulɛ bɛ nshɛŋ bɛŋ mo bɛŋ sɛŋe no akfuuŋ le wo nyume, gɛ taŋlo bɛŋ tɛ kɛɛ mwɛɛ mù Nyo duunyi yi kife kinɛ le gɛ nje la?
Gɛ taŋlo bɛŋ tɛ kwaji fiɛɛ fì chaaŋ fi taŋlo bɛŋ gêe gɛ?

Nɛ muh lé wu jô wo wu gɛɛne bɛ wo yeh yi nsa le, wo mo wo moŋ ki wo bɛ̂ɛŋ ki bɛŋ sêesɛ baaŋ a je, keefɛ wo gê wu chîi wo wu gɛ̂ɛŋ wu nyâ wo chiaaŋ yi muh wù sage bansa le gɛ, wu fêese lo wo chiaaŋ yi bamii ba nchi le tu ba lé ba fâa wo yeh yi cha le.
Nsɛŋe wo le lɛ gɛ taŋlo wo bu yu njɛ wo mɛsɛ wo laŋɛ finini fichii fì ba goone sɛŋ gɛ.”
